items.title: Warren Bernhardt interviewed by Monk Rowe, Bearsville, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: I remember George Wadenius came in and tried to play Larry Carlton’s solo on “Deacon Blues” and they didn’t like that at all.

ctx.x: Do those guys expect recreation of what’s on the albums?

I remember George Wadenius came in and tried to play Larry Carlton’s solo on “Deacon Blues” and they didn’t like that at all. They said, “Play your own solo.” So I think they wanted to recreate certain aspects, like tempo, the vibe of the song and the pulse. But all of a sudden he’ll come in with a completely new arrangement of a standard Steely Dan tune, I’m trying to remember the name of it, he wrote an entirely new thing for it, totally different. And you couldn’t even play it, it was so different. It’s very…
